decisions.rationale: dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across dataset.row_count 3322, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no dedupe step is proposed.

tailnum has distinct_count 3322, exactly equal to row_count 3322, with null_rate 0.0, so one row per aircraft registration is the smallest defensible grain; a reviewer should confirm uniqueness against the warehouse.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata: true and are dropped; _airbyte_extracted_at and _airbyte_meta each have distinct_count 1.

year, engines, seats and speed land as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sampled or distinct value is integral (engines 1.0-4.0, seats 2.0-450.0, year 1956.0-2013.0, speed 90.0-432.0), so each is cast to INTEGER.

speed has null_count 3299 of 3322 rows (null_rate 0.993076); the column is retained as nullable rather than dropped or imputed because its 13 distinct_values are still meaningful for the aircraft that report them.
year has null_count 70 (null_rate 0.021072); nulls are retained because an unknown manufacture year is a legitimate state for an airframe record.
is_fixed_wing is derived from type, whose three distinct_values separate fixed-wing aircraft from 'Rotorcraft', giving consumers a boolean filter without parsing text.

purpose: silver_nyc_planes is the cleaned aircraft reference table for the NYC flights domain: one row per aircraft tail number, carrying airframe attributes (manufacture year, type, manufacturer, model, engine count, seat count, cruise speed and engine kind) for joining to flight-level fact tables.
usage: Join to flight data on tailnum, which is the declared grain and is never null. year, engines, seats and speed are integers after the cast, so arithmetic and range filters work directly. Use is_fixed_wing to separate fixed-wing aircraft from rotorcraft without string matching. speed is nullable for almost every row, so any aggregate over it must be filtered or guarded deliberately rather than assumed complete.
limitations: speed is populated for only 23 of 3322 rows (null_rate 0.993076) and is unusable for fleet-wide analysis. year is missing for 70 rows (null_rate 0.021072). manufacturer is free text with 35 distinct values that include near-duplicates such as 'AIRBUS' and 'AIRBUS INDUSTRIE'; no normalization was applied because the profile gives no authoritative mapping. model mixes numeric and alphanumeric codes ('150', '172E', '210-5(205)') and is therefore kept as text. The grain of one row per tailnum is inferred from distinct_count 3322 matching row_count 3322 and must be confirmed against the warehouse before approval.
